The '''Raddan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]], within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> The system was the origin point of the article of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] known as the [[Raddan vermin-killer vest/Legends|Raddan vermin-killer's vest]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Raddan vermin-killer vest/Legends|Raddan vermin-killer's vest]]|system=Raddan [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Raddan system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square S-8.<ref name="TEA" />
